To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the sediment settling velocity and the surface area requirement of a sediment basin were significantly improved by flocculated sediment with dissolved PAM.
PAM-flocculated sediment can greatly reduce the sediment basin size in construction sites.
PAM-flocculated sediments settled faster and more efficiently than unflocculated sediment in a settling tube.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a simple and effective method to reduce sediment load in construction site runoff.
developing a new sediment management technology to reduce the size of the sediment basin and the cost associated with sediment control at construction sites.
the development of new sediment basin design for construction site that is more effective in removing suspended sediments from runoff water.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
flocculated sediment can greatly improve settling characteristics of sediment, and thus, sediment basins could be designed to be much smaller when sediment is flocculated.
PAM can be used as a chemical flocculant for sediment basin in construction sites to improve sediment settling.
PAM is effective in increasing settling of suspended sediment in a short time period.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the sediment basin size can be reduced up to 4-times by implementing chemically-assisted sedimentation.
flocculation of sediment by PAM is an efficient way to reduce the size of a sediment basin at construction site.
the flocculated sediments could be settled in a short period of time (1 min) and could reduce the sediment basin size at construction sites.
The main takeaway from our work is that
flocculated sediment can settle much faster than unflocculated counterpart, and the settling improvement can be more significant in finer textured soils.
flocculated sediment can be settled rapidly in a sediment basin, and thus a smaller basin can be designed for construction sites.
the use of chemical flocculation can greatly reduce sediment basin size in construction sites.
